profile.name: Gilang Risqi Pratama
profile.headline: Web Developer · Store Operations & Customer Service
profile.summary: A Bachelor's degree graduate in Informatics Engineering from Universitas Islam Syekh-Yusuf, with experience in web application development, data processing, administration, and operational support. Skilled in software development, database management, data recording and verification, and operational reporting. Accustomed to working with attention to detail, following procedures, communicating effectively, and collaborating within a team. Highly motivated to continuously learn, grow, and make meaningful contributions in a professional work environment.

responsibilities: Involved in developing a web application for daily report recording across multiple departments at a printing company.
Worked on the daily report input feature and the monthly report summary view.
Implemented Update and Delete functions for admin-role users.
Recorded equipment needs for program activities.
Assisted with procurement and inspection of goods.
Ensured equipment availability for program execution.
Checked received goods against delivery details; recorded stock withdrawals from the warehouse (dry goods and chiller stock).
Reported stock and operational activities per shift to the Head Shift or Supervisor.
Checked order completeness and packed orders; operated the POS system; assisted with customer service and cooking as needed.
Recorded income and expenses per shift; checked physical stock against inventory records.
Coordinated operations across one cashier and two water-refill staff members.
Monitored stock levels and operational needs; escalated customer complaints and operational issues to the business owner.

projects.title: Daily Report Web Application
projects.description: A web application for recording daily reports from multiple departments at a printing company. Features include daily report input, monthly report summary, and Update/Delete functions for admin users. Based on the most recent information provided, the application is still in use by the company.

projects.title: HiPlan
projects.description: HiPlan is a smart hiking platform that helps users explore Indonesia’s mountains through real-time weather updates, hiking difficulty predictions, estimated trek durations, and personalized mountain recommendations. Powered by Machine Learning, HiPlan brings essential hiking information together in one intuitive platform, helping hikers plan their adventures with greater confidence and preparation.
